ASK AAR SNAPSHOTS (ASK 493). Before the coordinator sends an AAR to the operator, the coordinator inserts one row into ask_aar_snapshots for each ASK revision the AAR covers. This is a rule: no AAR is sent before its rows are in. Each row is filled from SQL (the_wall, audit_log, pg_proc and the live version reads) and from the seats' posted md5s, and every field cites its source id in sources. A field with no source reads "not yet", never a guess. Rows are never edited: a later change to an ASK is a new row whose prior_row names the earlier one. The table accepts an insert only from the coordinator's seat (seat 36), refuses UPDATE and DELETE, has no anon or authenticated path, and writes an audit_log row on every insert. A new coordinator session registers to seat 36 before it inserts a row; until then, the table refuses its inserts. md5_match false means a written md5 was not among the PASS-graded md5s; the AAR reports it. The seats' duties do not change.
